rows: - `install-wf` of the `plan` job ended with exit code 143 (SIGTERM) 2 s into the step, every later step was skipped, and the job counted as failed with no failing step and no test run. `preflight` of the same run was green, nothing on the VM restarted at 16:38, and the run cannot be rerun with the repository token (403). The change in it (the log import moved from `infrastructure` to `application`, nine arch-rule ignores dropped) was left unproven by CI, so it ships again with the next push.
